description: Posts the human's public review of Geocode AI (1–5 stars, what they like and dislike, what they use it for), or replaces their existing one; each account has one review and earlier versions are kept. Only call it with the human's own rating and words, never invented ones. Published at once unless it holds links or the account is under a day old (then pending). Free; needs a key; one edit an hour. The human gets a thank-you email. Needs an API key or a connected account.

display_company.description: Company shown with it, if they want.

display_name.description: Name shown with the review (default: first name).

marketing_consent.description: May we quote it on our site and in marketing?

name: submit_review
title: Post or edit a review
